filesystem._note: Claude Code does NOT expand ${workspaceFolder} (that is a VS Code/Cursor variable) - use a literal absolute path, or delete this project-scope entry to inherit the user-scope filesystem server (project scope shadows user scope on name clash).

github._note: Official remote GitHub MCP server. Authenticate once via /mcp in an interactive claude session (OAuth). No PAT stored anywhere. Replaces the deprecated @modelcontextprotocol/server-github package.
